questions.stem_text:
If the activity of an enzyme is constant over a broad range of pH values, it is likely
that

options.A: the enzyme is inactive at all pH values
options.B: no ionizing groups on the enzyme or substrate participate in the reaction
options.C: only ionizing groups on the substrate participate in the reaction
options.D: ionizing groups on both the enzyme and substrate participate in the reaction
options.E: only non-ionizing groups on the substrate participate in the reaction

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - no ionizing groups on the enzyme or substrate participate in the reaction

questions.stem_text: How do cyanobacteria differ from green unicellular algae?

options.C: Green algae cannot reduce nitrogen compounds.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Cyanobacteria have no nuclei.

questions.stem_text:
Explain why simple diffusion is not sufficient to account for the passage of all of the
dissolved minerals into the cells of water plants.

options.A: Simple diffusion can only transport minerals when they are bound to oxygen molecules
options.B: Simple diffusion cannot occur against a concentration gradient
options.C: Simple diffusion requires specific carrier proteins for each mineral
options.D: Simple diffusion only works for organic compounds, not inorganic minerals
options.E: Simple diffusion can transport minerals in any concentration

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Simple diffusion cannot occur against a concentration gradient

questions.stem_text:
The pH of two lakes is measured. Lake A has a pH of 8.0; Lake B has a pH of 6.0. Which of
the following statements is correct about these lakes?

options.B: Lake B is 100 times more alkaline than Lake A.
options.C: The hydrogen ion concentration of Lake B is 104 M.
options.D: The pH of both lakes will decrease in response to acid rain.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The pH of both lakes will decrease in response to acid rain.

questions.stem_text: Are lower fasting plasma glucose levels at diagnosis of type 2 diabetes associated with improved outcomes?
questions.answer_explanation: People presenting with type 2 diabetes with lower initial glycemia who may be earlier in the course of their disease had fewer adverse clinical outcomes despite similar glycemic progression. Since most such people are asymptomatic at diagnosis, active case detection programs would be required to identify them.
According to the results of our study and the data from the international literature, the entity globulomaxillary cyst is no longer justified.

questions.stem_text: Is late-night salivary cortisol a better screening test for possible cortisol excess than standard screening tests in obese patients with Type 2 diabetes?
questions.answer_explanation: Late-night salivary cortisol has a poor specificity for cortisol excess in obese patients with T 2 DM with 24 hr UFC showing significantly better specificity in our population.

questions.stem_text: Chemoradiotherapy in the management of locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma esophagus: is surgical resection required?
questions.answer_explanation: The study suggests that there is no difference in clinical toxicity profiles or survival outcomes with either definitive chemoradiotherapy or chemoradiation followed by surgery in management of locally advanced esophageal cancer.

questions.stem_text: Is vitamin D deficiency a feature of pediatric celiac disease?
questions.answer_explanation: Our data showed no difference in 25(OH) D levels between normal children and those with CD when adjusted for body mass index.
